text:
lina: FYI KiteLabs onboarding is tripping 429s during SDK init. Their frontend CI spun up a bunch of browser sessions and were seeing preflight floods.

matt: Oof. Do we have org id + an example request? Could be ephemeral token fanout.

lina: Org: org_ktl_94. Example they run is browser SDK ephemeral flow: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sdk/init -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_ephemeral_abc" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"app":"kite-web","env":"prod"}'```

irene: What do headers show on 429s? x-rw-rl-*?

lina: Response headers: `x-rw-rl-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-rl-reset: 14`. Body: `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":14}`. They mint a fresh token per UI load; ~600 parallel starts during their rollout.

matt: That pattern will easily overwhelm preflight quota. Two quick mitigation paths: advise client to reuse ephemeral tokens for ~20-30s, and we can apply a temporary org-level preflight bump or enable coalescing for them.

irene: I'll approve a short quota bump window. sam, can you add +50 preflight QPS for org_ktl_94 for 15 minutes?

sam: deploy-bot: applied temp preflight +50 QPS to org_ktl_94 for 15m. Monitoring window open.

lina: Messaged the customer immediate patch: store ephemeral token at session level and add jittered exponential backoff on init. Sent tiny snippet.

lina: ```js
// client-side minimal change
let token = await getEphemeralToken();
setTimeout(() => { token = null }, 30000); // reuse for 30s
await retry(async () => fetch('/v1/sdk/init', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }), { retries: 5, minTimeout: 200, maxTimeout: 2000, jitter: true });
```

matt: Created ENG ticket INF-1124 to investigate smarter preflight coalescing and an auto-backoff heuristic for ephemeral-heavy browser flows. Tag: eng-runtime.

irene: Early signs good; 429s dropped in last 3 minutes after the bump. Customer asked ETA for full safe ramp.

lina: Scheduled enablement call tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk through patch + token reuse. I'll attach snippet and the docs page.

sam: deploy-bot: temp bump expires in ~12m. Will extend if 429 rate remains above threshold, or will revert if stable.

matt: Account health note: set renewal risk to "low-medium" until onboarding completes. Add note: "initial ramp caused preflight throttling; mitigated via temporary quota bump and client token reuse patch."

lina: Follow-ups: 1) confirm SDK change deployed 2) monitor for 1h post-rollout 3) if 429s >5% re-escalate to eng-runtime.

irene: Good catch, team. Keeping thread for call notes. :thumbsup:
